info.title: Portal Research Retained Current-Source API
info.description: RS-02 named same-origin reads over Portal-retained, P05-sealed QuantBT 1.1.1 Advanced WFO data. These routes never run QuantBT, reopen source bytes, expose an artifact/table/lease input or raw fold/candidate payload, or replace P04 fixed-run contracts. Parameter maps are capped at 24 declared fields. Runtime Zod contracts are strict; this document is the generated-client source. RF-05 CG-P13-09 (additive): a run whose admitted profile can never be retained in this lane (the P04 fixed qualification) is answered 200 with `LaneNotApplicable` (schema_version research.current-source-not-applicable.v1) on every read, so a screen can skip the lane without an error; PENDING_SOURCE / PENDING_RETENTION / NOT_RETAINED_LEGACY / NOT_RETAINED_TERMINAL remain 409 RESEARCH_CURRENT_SOURCE_CONFLICT refusals whose Problem `details.lane_state` names the state. W1 (additive): provenance names one of two lane pairs — rs02.quantbt-advanced-wfo.v1/rs02.delta-wfo-global.v1 or rs02.quantbt-signal-notional-wfo.v1/rs02.delta-signal-notional-wfo.v1 (the Delta signal-notional WFO execution profile); a WFO run without a seal is a PENDING_SOURCE/PENDING_RETENTION refusal, never LaneNotApplicable. W3 (additive, P13–P15 on real WFO data): Evidence adds `claim` (the S04 claim strip, verbatim QuantBT tokens, CG-P13-07) and `fold_verdicts` (per-fold S_OOS/decay/trades/max DD/return/worst bar with the versioned server rule research.fold-verdict.v1, CG-P13-08); EvidenceSeries observation kinds serve up to 2000 retained rows, then an extrema-preserving bucket sample, with a whole-relation `envelope` (CG-P13-05); Split folds add `anatomy` (warm-up/label-horizon/purge/embargo/validation windows) and the split adds run-level `guards` (CG-P14-02); Search trials/candidates add typed `state` and `facts` (stage, objective kind, fold scope, metrics, objective components), selection adds `roles` (raw IS best vs selected vs centroid), plus `search_contract`, `ledger.fold_filter` (`?fold=`) and `diagnostics.probe` (CG-P15-03/04). A seal retained before W3 answers every new fact as a typed absence. W5b (additive, P17 on the signal-notional route): each Replay Observation carries `bar` — the candle QuantBT consumed (the run's analysed HMD bar) and the final account's own fee/turnover/funding/rejected orders with a running checkpoint; `state_at_cursor.bar` is that checkpoint at the selected playhead; Replay adds `execution` (route contract, counted order/fill/trade records, totals, fold capital with per-fold segments and seek cursors, an OHLC overview of at most 160 extrema-keeping buckets, and the sequence policy) and route_capabilities for transitions/fees/funding/fold_capital/trades/partial_fills/oco/multi_leg/sl_tp/mae_mfe/execution_events. `GET .../current-source/replay/transitions` pages the close-target transition ledger (target transitions settled at the close with the account fee — never fills) over the original bar ordinal. A window with a hole in its dense sealed ordinals is refused 503 RESEARCH_CURRENT_SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GAP. A seal retained before W5b answers `bar: null` and `execution.state = NOT_RETAINED_LEGACY` (RS02_SEAL_PREDATES_W5B_REPLAY_BAR_LEDGER). P17-T14 (additive): Replay adds route_capabilities.child_audit and execution.child_audit (QuantBT strategy_lifecycle policy, source record count, records dropped by the source, run fingerprint); `GET .../current-source/replay/child-audit?fold=` returns one fold's QuantBT strategy-isolation records (one per child strategy instance, <= 64, in QuantBT's order) with their original ids: audit_ordinal (row in QuantBT's table), candidate_id, fold_id, seed. A seal without the table answers NOT_RETAINED_LEGACY (RS02_SEAL_PREDATES_P17_CHILD_AUDIT). X2 (additive, 1.7.0): Search adds `declared_space` (the A10b historical binding of the retained lane profile, with θ*'s DR-02 placement and exact levels) and `surface` (spec 06 A2–A5/B4 derived on the server from every retained trial: placements, quintile-threshold ramp, 12-bin counts and means, top-decile share at θ*, Spearman |ρ| proxy); Freeze adds `declared_space`, `stage4_binding` (CG-P16-02, HiFi 07 F4) and `parameter_authority` (CG-P16-03). An older server omits these blocks and a client renders its typed absence. E5 (additive, Screen 06 Stage B): Search adds `pool` (research.current-source-search-pool.v1): trials evaluated, completed-unpruned trials, feasible (NOT_APPLICABLE: QuantBT's walk-forward study declares no constraints), the top-IS K with the rule that sized it — published only when the retained candidate ledger is exactly the pool and QuantBT's own rule on published inputs gives the same K, else a typed absence — the re-evaluated count and its fold scope, the selected count, and θ*'s per-fold decay verbatim from QuantBT's selected-trial fold metrics; `search_contract.top_is_k` carries that K. Each candidate adds `max_drawdown`: the stitched OOS path's drawdown for the selected candidate under the global schedule (source RETAINED_STITCHED_OOS_PATH), a typed absence for every other candidate (QuantBT's candidate ledger publishes no drawdown). Trial `constraints`/`feasible` are NOT_APPLICABLE for the same no-constraints reason.

get.description: Cursor-bearing response is private/no-store. Use cursor/before for a relation page or at for a minted playhead; never reuse a stale cache body.

parameters.name: candidate_cursor
parameters.description: Independent candidate-page cursor, scoped to this workspace/run/revision/operation/table. Never a TRIAL cursor.

post.summary: Admit one bounded what-if diagnostic job (≤81 unique evaluations) for the grid the reader saw
post.description: Explicit, origin/CSRF-protected action. Deduplicated by grid key: a second click replays the in-flight job. Never runs on a GET, a mount or a slider move. Refused with 409 when the sealed bytes do not verify, the grid changed, or another diagnostic for the run is in flight.

200.description: Admitted, replayed, or nothing to evaluate

get.description: Cursor-bearing response is private/no-store. Rows are retained research-model samples, never broker execution state.
W5b: target transitions settled at the close with the account fee, keyset over the original bar ordinal. Private/no-store; never fills, never a trade pairing.
P17-T14: one fold's child audit from the sealed local FOLD row; no compute, no source read.

PortalCsrf.name: x-portal-csrf
PortalCsrf.description: Same-origin CSRF proof for the explicit what-if action.

At.name: at
At.description: Opaque playhead minted by this exact run/revision/relation.

Fold.name: fold
Fold.description: W3: keep ledger rows whose published fold scope covers this retained fold id; cursors bind the filter.

ChildAuditFold.name: fold
ChildAuditFold.description: P17-T14: a retained fold id (the split's fold_id).

Problem.description: Typed refusal with no source path, table selector, artifact locator, lease, raw market slice or credential.

Split.description: Observed sealed WFO split, fixed-profile not-applicable lane, or terminal-without-retained-split absence

Freeze.description: Local retained manifest/batch-receipt verification; no GET reopens source artifact bytes

ReplayChildAudit.description: P17-T14 one fold's QuantBT strategy-isolation records

RetainedAnalytics.title: ResearchRetainedAnalytics
RetainedAnalytics.description: E11/E14 source-time analytics sealed with one immutable artifact/projection. UTC milliseconds, exact decimals, no compute on GET. Child-tape trade count is not an audited ledger.

net_oos_return.description: Legacy field name; exact Mode 5 facts carry FULL_SAMPLE scope, never an untouched OOS claim.

RetainedAnalyticsV2.title: ResearchRetainedAnalyticsV2
RetainedAnalyticsV2.description: D-AN-01 source-time all-time OOS descriptive analytics. v1 remains readable. No rolling detailed-screen metrics or reconstructed PnL/fills/objectives.

RetainedAnalyticsV2Distributions.title: ResearchAllTimeDistributions
RetainedAnalyticsV2Distributions.description: Additive precomputed OOS companion, including a partial leading month. Daily histogram is all-time, not a trade or per-bar histogram. Original seals remain immutable.

EnrichedAnalysisDistributions.title: ResearchAllTimeDistributions
EnrichedAnalysisDistributions.description: Additive precomputed OOS companion, including a partial leading month. Daily histogram is all-time, not a trade or per-bar histogram. Original seals remain immutable.

OptimizerDisclosure.description: Source-retained optimizer evidence. Native objective and selector ranking score are separate. Bootstrap statistics are synthetic proxy, not realized OOS. A centroid has parameters and null trial identity; Mode 4 uses IS only without fabricated inner folds; Mode 5 is full-sample calibration, never untouched OOS.

ProtocolDisclosure.description: Native Three Window facts: calibration uses IS and OOS only; independent holdout runs after frozen selection. UTC half-open windows are contiguous. Runtime verifies every emitted series point stays inside its own window. Observation/analytics rows are calibration OOS, never relabelled untouched holdout. No filesystem locator or engine input is exposed.

RunDeclarationAlphaVersionDeclaration.description: Safe immutable AlphaVersion validator inputs, not raw source, provenance or mutable execution instructions.

AppliedTemporalGuardProof.description: Read-only checks against the same immutable retained observation index. Purge excludes exactly its configured bars before the label-horizon and test. Embargo follows the test and may be clipped only at the verified dataset tail. Zero is valid only when source windows explicitly publish zero; missing historical facts are NOT_CHECKABLE. This is not a strict-OOS selection/holdout/certification assertion.

ReplayNavigationWindow.description: Retained fold start/end are exact source bounds; sums may overlap. Holdout AVAILABLE requires completed Three Window retained custody, never pre-execution permission. Old seals remain typed absent; WFO has no independent Holdout.

DisplayCausalSelection.description: Source-owned selection for this outer fold only. Objective uses nested inner validation, not outer OOS. Candidate metrics have a separate post-selection outer scope. Retained IDs are study-qualified; local source trial IDs remain in trial facts. Runtime validates exact inner count, unique IDs and train-before-test ranges inside outer IS; no engine wall clock is inferred. W1 ordinal: display only, source number + 1. Qualified studies require a retained native study/trial mapping and STUDY_LOCAL scope; never a run-global trial. Null carries an explicit reason. Not a digest or selection identity.

CausalSelection.description: Source-owned selection for this outer fold only. Objective uses nested inner validation, not outer OOS. Candidate metrics have a separate post-selection outer scope. Retained IDs are study-qualified; local source trial IDs remain in trial facts. Runtime validates exact inner count, unique IDs and train-before-test ranges inside outer IS; no engine wall clock is inferred.

source_binding_digest.description: Hash of exact retained artifact, producer attempt/lease, request/effective/data and historical execution profile bindings. Private attempt identifiers are not exposed.

P11StageEvents.description: P11 records Portal orchestration, not engine chronology: S3 completion can precede the actual study inside S4. No search-completed, pool-frozen, first-OOS-read or causal-order assertion is inferred. Missing fields carry individual reasons; legacy responses may omit this additive block.

SplitTerminalAbsence.description: Durable run ended without retained execution split. Named terminal absence, not a pending source request or a planned/observed fold projection. Nothing here grants source access or a retry action. P04/imported fixed NOT_APPLICABLE stays unchanged.

Provenance.description: Exact historical/global/causal custody pair; mixing is refused.

source_revision.description: Immutable retained seal facts for this view. Does not include presentation, byte-verification receipts or utility-job state. Different view prefixes may share the seal hash. Not an HTTP cache validator.

presentation_revision.description: Exact response representation validator, including display/verification changes. Use the HTTP ETag for caching. Existing revision remains unchanged for backward cursor/reader compatibility.

run_declaration.description: Immutable bound version declaration and explicit requested overrides. Never current registry defaults or evidence of actual runtime/sampler execution. Optional during additive rollout.

scope.description: Final outer-fold deployment selection only, not a run-global parameter bundle.

Selection.description: W1 ordinal: display only, source number + 1. Qualified studies require a retained native study/trial mapping and STUDY_LOCAL scope; never a run-global trial. Null carries an explicit reason. Not a digest or selection identity.

source_absences.description: Source-owned absences. A WFO final account is not selected-candidate IS equity. E11 source-time summary_analytics uses QuantBT daily resampling and rolling_sharpe(window=63); a qualified long run omits rolling_sharpe absence, while older or short seals publish their exact typed reason. Both optional fields preserve older captures.

basis.description: V1 remains readable for old captures. New retained WFO reads use V2: both endpoints name inclusive observed bars. This does not attest applied purge or embargo.

source_trial_count.description: Complete retained TRIAL rows; exact immutable recipe allows at most 400 per study and 6400 across bounded fold-local studies. Ledger pages remain at most 200 rows.

candidates.description: Complete source_candidate_count; rows are one independent candidate page. Large pools use 50 rows, small historical pools remain whole. Follow page.next_cursor as candidate_cursor; no trial cursor can address this relation. Selection/pool calculations always use all retained candidates.

classification_basis.description: Three Window classification derived by Portal from sealed native protocol disclosure, not a verbatim WFO claim or untouched calibration OOS.

surfaces_by_study.description: Exactly three native Stage-A trials per admitted outer study, independently scoped. Causal uses inner validation; per-fold decay uses outer OOS. No run-global pool, objective or theta is invented.

sampler_evidence.description: Immutable requested config, retained trial observations and optional actual public Optuna-hook capture from a new confined child. Private TPE densities and historical traces are never inferred.

ArtifactByteVerification.description: A10a: the newest durable byte-verification receipt for this run's sealed P05 artifact (written only by the explicit P16 POST verify). MISMATCH or MISSING BLOCKS the frozen chain.

WhatIfCell.description: One node of the 9×9 grid. EVALUATED only from an exact existing evaluation with the same key (retained parent trial or sealed diagnostic grid); MISSING/QUEUED/NOT_DEFINED carry no number and are never 0 or interpolated.

WhatIf.description: W5a A10c Screen-07 what-if sandbox for a sealed Delta WFO run. A GET serves exact existing evaluations only and never enqueues or evaluates; the explicit POST evaluate admits one bounded diagnostic job. ΔJ is preview only.

verdict.description: Only the admitted causal/inner profile can earn a data-time causal verdict, from retained own-fold selection and inner ranges. Global selection never earns it; engine wall clocks remain separately absent.

FoldOrdering.description: W5a P16-T02/T11: per-fold ordering on two axes (data time, wall clock); the per-fold causal verdict from QuantBT's own claims; the out-of-sample generation child compared with the frozen selection by QuantBT's candidate identity.

BoundWarning.description: DR-02 research.bound-warning.v1: one relative definition shared by Search S06 and Freeze S07. Reference space is the declared range; AT_BOUND at <=6% or >=94%, NEAR_BOUND at <=18% or >=82% (inclusive, exact decimal); NOT_APPLICABLE with a typed reason for zero-width, categorical or out-of-declaration values. A display diagnostic, never a gate and never a claim that the value is not an optimum.

DeclaredSpaceParameter.description: One declared numeric parameter of the historical binding with the sealed θ* value, its exact levels, its server placement and the DR-02 warning. Declared values are inside the params digest (CG-P16-03).

DeclaredSpace.description: X2 · B3: the declared space a retained run searched — the A10b historical binding its retained lane profile was sealed under (never this build's constants). An unregistered lane is NOT_PUBLISHED P16_HISTORICAL_PARAMETER_BINDING_NOT_REGISTERED.

parameters.description: Exact persisted trial parameters for this source_ordinal, identical to ledger.parameters; never display-step rounded.

SurfacePoint.description: One trial on the surface: every coordinate is the server's placement inside the declared range; objective_bucket is its quintile among complete trials; best_so_far is the running best in source order.

PoolRule.description: QuantBT _candidate_count: K = top_is_k when configured, else ceil(n x top_is_fraction) in float64, capped to [1, n]; n = completed unpruned IS trials. AVAILABLE only when k equals the retained pool.

SearchPool.description: E5: the pool a retained WFO run froze and theta*'s per-fold decay, from the sealed ledger only.

frozen_at_utc_ms.description: Legacy field: new responses return null because P11 S4 completion is not engine pool freeze. Retained P11 times are published separately in Search.stage_events.

frozen_at_source.description: Legacy source tag accepted for historical captures only. New responses return null and never present S4 completion as pool freeze.

CandidateDrawdown.description: E5: a candidate's OOS max drawdown fraction, or a typed absence (QuantBT's candidate ledger publishes none).

BoundaryGap.description: E14 (5.11): one crossing from a fold's outer test window into the next one's, as QuantBT's account execution plan published it.

SplitGapScan.description: E14 (5.11): the boundary-integrity gap scan of the retained lane - QuantBT account_execution_plan.boundary_events, verbatim. expected_boundary_count is the retained fold plan's own crossing count (folds - 1), so a scan that covered fewer says so. A boundary scan, not a per-window coverage census.

SplitStitch.description: E14 (5.12): stitched OOS provenance. QuantBT publishes no digest of the stitched series, so digest is the portal's own sha256 over the retained stitch plan and basis says exactly that; it is never an engine artifact digest. boundary_check is the HiFi's "verified against fold boundaries", run over retained values only.

SearchSurface.description: X2 · B3 (spec 06 A2–A5, B4): the trial surface of a retained WFO run, derived on the server from every retained trial (<= 64 under RS-02, <= 600 points by rule; `sampling` names whether anything was left out). The browser draws coordinates only: placements, quintile ramp steps, 12-bin counts and means, the top-decile share at θ* and the Spearman |ρ| proxy (not fANOVA; NOT_APPLICABLE under 8 complete trials) are all published here.

Stage4Binding.description: X2 · B4 · CG-P16-02 (HiFi 07 F4): sealed vs replayed params and sealed vs runtime bundle, compared on the server under a named identity rule per lane. RS-02: QuantBT candidate identity of the sealed θ* vs each fold's out-of-sample generation child, and the strategy fingerprint of the frozen candidate's selection-stage children vs the generation child's. P04: the registered fixed bundle and adapter digests vs what the P04 child executed (its P14 receipt and producer row). Any MISMATCH is DRIFT; a missing side is NOT_COMPARED with its reason, never a tick.

ParameterAuthority.description: X2 · B4 · CG-P16-03 (guide §6.6): declared/swept/pinned values live in the params (θ) digest; values the code fixes are outside it and are covered by the protected code digest bound into the adapter contract digest. The Delta kernel publishes no machine-readable list of its fixed values, so `code_fixed.values` is a typed absence (P04_DELTA_KERNEL_PUBLISHES_NO_CODE_FIXED_VALUE_LIST) with the exact hash scope.

FrozenSelection.description: The sealed θ* as Screen 07 reads it (not the Screen 06 selection roles). W1 ordinal: display only, source number + 1. Qualified studies require a retained native study/trial mapping and STUDY_LOCAL scope; never a run-global trial. Null carries an explicit reason. Not a digest or selection identity.

scope.description: Final outer-fold deployment selection only, not a run-global parameter bundle.

presentation_revision.description: Separate additive presentation; immutable replay source revision, source digest and frozen Report/RC pins are unchanged.

presentation_digest.description: Canonical SHA256 of presentation_revision plus identity/is_window/oos_window/holdout_window. Neither a source digest nor an HTTP cache validator (Replay is private no-store).

LaneNotApplicable.description: RF-05 CG-P13-09: the run's immutable P10 adapter binding is the P04 fixed qualification, which can never be sealed into the RS-02 Advanced-WFO lane. Nothing is pending; do not retry.

retainable_profile_id.description: The P04 fixed qualification always emits rs02.delta-wfo-global.v1 (byte-stable).

LaneState.description: RF-05 CG-P13-09: `details.lane_state` of a 409 RESEARCH_CURRENT_SOURCE_CONFLICT. PENDING_SOURCE: the run has not completed. PENDING_RETENTION: completed, sealed artifact not yet retained. NOT_RETAINED_LEGACY: a 1.0.8 metadata row, never retained. NOT_RETAINED_TERMINAL: cancelled/failed without a retained artifact.

code.description: A ProblemCode on these routes; the session guard may answer 401 with its own code.

ClaimStrip.description: S04 claim strip: engine tokens verbatim; an unpublished fact keeps value null with a typed reason.

total_oos_trades.description: E11: the run's OOS trade count, summed over the published per-fold counts under the same score_basis as mean_*. Withheld whenever a fold did not publish one — a partial sum is a smaller number wearing the run's name. Optional so a pre-E11 capture still validates; the server always emits it.

FoldVerdicts.description: Per-fold verdicts under a versioned server rule; the frontend holds no threshold.

TrialFacts.description: Public completed-objective facts. When pruned is true, all five metrics are PrunedTrialMetric and objective_components is NOT_PUBLISHED/TRIAL_PRUNED_NO_OBJECTIVE with null formula and no terms. Raw retained pruning-step values and seal digests remain immutable; a COMPLETE trial's exact zero stays numeric.

ProblemCode.description: CG-P17-02: every `error.code` a retained current-source read can return. 409 CONFLICT carries `details.lane_state`; SEQUENCE_GAP (503, W5b) is a retained relation read back with a hole — never retried into an invented row.

ReplayBar.description: W5b: one bar of the final account. `transition` is a change of the engine's accepted position; on close_target_v2 it is settled at the close and is never a fill.

params_digest.description: Sealed global-study selection digest; not proof of per-bar replay-runtime parameter equality.

ReplayExecution.description: W5b: what the signal-notional route really produced, retained at seal time.

equity_continuity.description: CONTINUOUS: one stitched account (fold k starts at fold k-1's end equity). RESET_PER_FOLD: each fold is its own account and must not be compounded.

anyOf.description: At most 160 OHLC buckets over the whole run: a bucket's high/low are the true extrema of its bars, so the run's price range survives the downsample.

source_ordinal.description: Original bar ordinal; sparse across transitions, never renumbered.

audit_ordinal.description: Row in QuantBT's own strategy_lifecycle_table: the original child-audit id.
